title: EOMONTH ( DATE ( 2008, 3, 3 ), 1.5 ) is May 31, 2008: the months argument is rounded to 2

source.quote: The following expression returns May 31, 2008, because the months argument is rounded to 2.
source.supports: the documented example = EOMONTH("March 3, 2008",1.5), with the date given by DATE instead of text

derivation: 1.5 rounds to 2; two months after March 2008 is May 2008, whose last day is the 31st.
